articles.excerpt: Atlas Olive Oils Biochar Project is a Verified Carbon Standard (VCS) project registered on the Verra registry in Morocco. The project is currently listed as "Under development". It applies VM0044 methodology. Estimated annual emission reductions are 19,582 tonnes CO₂ equivalent per year. Project proponent: Atlas Olive Oils. Crediting period runs 2026-06-01 to 2033-05-31.
